name: icon-button
title: Icon button
purpose: A button that shows only an icon, for a familiar action where a text label has no room.
whenToUse: For a familiar action in a dense row or a toolbar, such as copying a branch name or opening a menu of more actions.
For a toggle that shows or hides part of the view, such as the terminal, with aria-pressed.
whenNotToUse: When the icon would not be understood without words. Use a button with a text label, with or without a leading icon.
For the main action of a view. Use a primary button with a text label.
To go to another view or another site. Use a link.
For a setting that is saved. Use a switch or a checkbox.

variants.name: bordered
variants.use: The default: ds-button ds-icon-button on one element. A standalone action that should read as a control.

variants.name: quiet
variants.use: ds-button ds-button--quiet ds-icon-button. No border until it is hovered or pressed, for a row or a toolbar that holds several.

sizes.name: default
sizes.use: A square as tall as a control at the density of its container: 36px by default, 28px where data-ds-density is compact, and 44px where it is touch and on every coarse pointer. The icon is 16px at every size.

sizes.name: small
sizes.use: 28px square at every density, for a toolbar. On a coarse pointer it is drawn the same and its pointer target is 44px square, so keep 16px or more between two of them. Do not add ds-button--small to an icon button.

sizes.name: xsmall
sizes.use: 24px square at every density, the smallest target a fine pointer allows, for the one action inside a dense row. On a coarse pointer its pointer target is 44px square, so a row holds one.

accessibility: Use a button element with type="button", carrying ds-button and ds-icon-button. The icon is an svg with class ds-button__icon and aria-hidden="true".

The button must have an accessible name: an aria-label on the button, or text in a span with ds-visually-hidden inside it. The name is a verb and what it acts on, such as Copy branch name, and it names the item when the action repeats in a list, such as More actions for run 2184.

For a toggle, set aria-pressed="true" or "false" and switch it on each press. Keep the same name in both states: the state is announced from aria-pressed. The stylesheet adds a border, a sunken fill and a bar under the icon while it is on.
Disabled, aria-disabled and aria-busy behave as on the button. While busy, the spinner takes the place of the icon and the name says what is happening, such as Copying branch name.
Enter and Space activate it. Both come from the button element.
A tooltip may repeat the name for sighted readers, and is never the only place the name lives.
